Your week ahead: elections, petrol and the rand 🗓️🇿🇦

A big week for your pocket and your vote:

🗳️ Mon 2 – Tue 3 Nov: special votes, Local Government Elections
🇺🇸 Tue 3 Nov: US midterm elections
🇿🇦 Wed 4 Nov: Local Government Elections (public holiday)

⛽ Wed 4 Nov: new petrol and diesel prices, plus the fuel levy cut starts: R1.50 a litre off petrol and R3 off diesel until 1 December. Forecasts disagree, from a small drop to about R2 a litre up, so wait for the official price, announced just before Wednesday.

📊 Coming up: inflation figures on 18 Nov and the Reserve Bank's interest rate decision on 19 Nov.

What are you watching most closely this week? 👇
